write_up: A recruiter sees a security analyst who builds detections, leads incident response and works with a red team. Your Splunk line is the model: it names the work, ties it to MITRE ATT&CK and shows the reduction in false positives.

Your resume isn't likely to be the reason you don't hear back. How competitive the job is matters too. One useful improvement: show what your alert enrichment adds, so a reader can see what the automation does.
